column3: The United States Congress founded the Smithsonian Institution which reports directly to the President. Its goals were and remain the support of research and expeditions, as well as the popularization of science. column3: The Serb Ilya Garashanin demanded in his writing 'Natshertanye' ('Draft') the unity of all southern Slavs in the struggle against their Austrian and Ottoman oppressors.
